title: Read Brannock Marks Ten Years of Community Literacy Work
excerpt: Ten years after The Wexmoor Foundation convened community leaders around a simple question, how many of our third graders can read, Read Brannock has grown into a county-wide network of schools, libraries, families and volunteers.
body: Ten years after The Wexmoor Foundation convened community leaders around a simple question, how many of our third graders can read, Read Brannock has grown into a county-wide network of schools, libraries, families and volunteers.

The anniversary celebration at the Harlow Springs Public Library recognized the teachers, tutors and family literacy partners who carry the work forward each day. Executive Director Dr. Renee Callahan noted that the Foundation remains a committed lead funder of Read Brannock's operations.
Read Brannock will release an updated community literacy scorecard later this spring.

title: The Wexmoor Foundation Statement on Teacher Residency Pathways
excerpt: The Wexmoor Foundation shares a few reflections on its support of teacher residency pathways across North Carolina and what we have learned from partners preparing new teachers for high-need classrooms.
body: The Wexmoor Foundation shares a few reflections on its support of teacher residency pathways across North Carolina and what we have learned from partners preparing new teachers for high-need classrooms.

We believe that beginning teachers deserve a full year of practice alongside an excellent mentor teacher before leading a classroom of their own. Residency programs that pair rigorous coursework with that kind of clinical experience are showing promising early results in retention and classroom readiness.
We will continue to learn alongside our partners and share what we learn with the field.

title: Brannock County Schools Expands Literacy Coaching Network
excerpt: Brannock County Schools announced that every elementary school in the district will have access to a trained literacy coach beginning in the 2025-26 school year.
body: Brannock County Schools announced that every elementary school in the district will have access to a trained literacy coach beginning in the 2025-26 school year.

The expansion builds on a three-year pilot supported by the Brannock County Schools Education Fund and the Brannock Coaching Collaborative. Coaches work alongside kindergarten through third grade teachers on foundational reading instruction and on using screening data to plan small-group lessons.

title: Dr. Renee Callahan Named Executive Director of The Wexmoor Foundation
excerpt: The Wexmoor Foundation Board of Directors announced the selection of Dr. Renee Callahan as the Foundation's next Executive Director, following a national search.
body: The Wexmoor Foundation Board of Directors announced the selection of Dr. Renee Callahan as the Foundation's next Executive Director, following a national search.

Dr. Callahan spent twelve years as a classroom teacher and elementary school principal before leading a statewide educator preparation initiative. She succeeds the Foundation's founding Executive Director and begins her role on August 1, 2023.
"Renee brings deep classroom experience and a clear focus on results for students," said Board Chair Margaret Wexmoor Ellison.
